build_BaichuanForCausalLM: build a BaichuanForCausalLM model from a HuggingFace config for inference-only Baichuan 7B or 13B
create_BaiChuanDecoderLayer: create a BaiChuanDecoderLayer with attention, MLP, and RMSNorm for each transformer layer
run_BaiChuanModel_forward: run the BaiChuanModel forward pass with input_ids, positions, and forward batch for token generation
load_BaiChuanBaseForCausalLM_weights: load HuggingFace weights into BaiChuanBaseForCausalLM with support for gate_up_proj sharding and Baichuan2 normalization
test_BaiChuanAttention_forward: test BaiChuanAttention forward pass with QKV projection, RoPE or ALIBI positional encoding, and RadixAttention
